INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. B — Ice melting to water

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.

5. D — 100 °C

6. C — newton (N)

7. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

11. B — Glucose and oxygen

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
